🌹 Birthday Love Note
Written with all my heart

My Dearest Livi,

Happy Birthday to the girl who effortlessly stole my heart and continues to make it skip a beat every single day. Having you in my life, Livi, is the greatest blessing I could ever ask for.

I love the way your deep brown eyes light up when you're happy, your cute little pouts and winks, the sweet drawings and handmade paper roses you make for me, and how even a simple video call with you turns my whole day around. You make ordinary moments feel like pure magic.

On your special day, I want to promise you that I'll always be right by your side—cheering for your dreams, holding your hand through every season, and loving you more fiercely with each passing year. May this year bring you as much happiness, warmth, and love as you bring into my world.

With all my love,

Yours Forever & Always ❤️
